editor.world.lede: World mode: this card is a world with several characters. The world itself is the character definition under Persona, and the world-level lore is the Lorebook bound to this card; only the characters live here. Each turn the world first decides what happened and who is present, then up to a few characters answer in their own voice, each knowing only what they saw or were told.

mine.consent.title: Submit for community review
mine.consent.message: After you submit, this site uses your current sign-in to read this card's full definition (persona, openings, worldbook, regex rules and layout, extra instructions) and keeps a copy for review. Only reviewers see it, for review only. The copy is deleted as soon as the review ends (approved or rejected) or you withdraw the card. It goes on the board once approved; changing its name, summary, cover, tags or opening later means another review.

download.title: Download Hearthroom
download.intro: Keep the role-card community on your phone. Come back to find characters and write stories.
download.requirement: Android 8.0 or later · Internet connection required
download.step1: Download the APK on your Android phone, then open the file.
download.step2: If prompted, allow this browser to install apps.
download.step3: Tap Install. Once installed, open Hearthroom from your home screen.
download.updates: When an app update is available, you can read what changed before downloading it and confirming installation. Website features update with the site, without reinstalling the app.
download.browserIntro: Open Hearthroom in your browser. You can also add it to your home screen or install it as a web app.
download.ios: iPhone / iPad: open this site in Safari, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.
download.desktop: Desktop: choose Install Hearthroom from the menu or address bar of a supported browser. If that option is unavailable, use the website directly.
download.bannerBody: Install the app and return to the community from your home screen.
authorization.notice: Hearthroom encrypts and saves the provider authorization you approve so you can use it after signing in on another device.
authorization.storage: Hearthroom stores your linked provider identity and encrypted access and refresh credentials. Encryption keys are managed separately from the database. Your provider password is never received.
authorization.access: The backend renews credentials within the permissions you grant. The browser and player hold short-lived access credentials in memory. Administrators with backend execution access can still decrypt stored credentials; this storage is not risk-free.
authorization.control: You can stop authorization here or revoke it on the provider’s authorized apps page. Active credentials are removed after revocation; encrypted credentials are retained for retry if revocation fails. Account links and community records remain.
authorization.migration: Your first sign-in through this flow requires authorization again. Old browser-only credentials are cleared rather than uploaded automatically.
authorization.disconnectConfirm: Stopping authorization for {provider} affects all devices. You must authorize it again to use this service. Your community account and records remain.
authorization.pending: Hearthroom has stopped using this authorization and is retrying revocation with the provider.
authorization.identity: Account links remain. Provider authorization can be stopped or granted again without increasing community publishing limits.
